I48.title: Verified evaluation corpus, blind rule classification, binding-aware renaming and matched scale controls
I48.scope: Instrument delivery only. I51 runs HOLON on the corpus, I52 runs baselines, and I53 calibrates the solver.

predictions.claim: At least 20 distinct historical Go/Solidity bug fixes, with system quotas 8/6/3/3 and at least 12 defects in two or more non-rollup systems, follow the frozen traversal and first-parent selection rules, have substantive code diffs, and have parseable source bundles.

Every corpus item has a provenance-verified label-free blind packet; two independent sessions attest to the same packet digest, preserve raw outputs, and constrained adjudication reports agreement and Cohen's kappa.

Go and Solidity bundle renaming is independently checked for lexical binding preservation, shadowing, parser validity, literal/comment preservation and exact inverse restoration across every source file.

All twelve executable controls are evaluated live; true proofs and false concrete counter-laws pass Bend, while false controls pass at every standard-budget scale and refute at witness scale; solver inputs stay isolated.
